items.title: Ernest "Kid" Milton Interview, 1961-04-26
items.q: I didn't know everybody in the band.

ctx.x: No, no, no, he said no, he said he worked... Barry did go there, but... He said he worked for Hall's... Yeah, no, no, no. He said he worked for Hall's drum. Who else is in the band? I didn't know everybody in the band.
Who's the pianist? Oh, well, Wiggins. Oh, that's right.
Yeah. And Rene Moikindell. Rene Moikindell.
